comment: Reachability gaps the Spring AOT pass cannot see, for the `smith-studio` native binary. Same division of labour as the builder's builder-native-hints: this file is hand-written and never regenerated, and studio-traced-hints beside it is generated by running the executable jar under the tracing agent (-agentlib:native-image-agent=config-merge-dir=...) over the REST surface and the module's own test suite. No script maintains that directory: scripts/native-hints.sh regenerates only the BUILDER's traced file, so the studio's goes stale silently -- re-run the agent over the jar after changing the REST surface, and drop entries for classes that exist only in target/test-classes before committing. Add an entry here when the image boots but a route answers differently from the JVM jar. RESOURCES. static/**: the studio serves the built Vue SPA from classpath:/static through config/SpaWebConfig, whose PathResourceResolver asks for each path BY NAME (location.createRelative), which an image can do only for files that were registered. The directory is gitignored (.gitignore) and written into src/main/resources/static by frontend-maven-plugin at generate-resources, so the glob is deliberately a wildcard rather than the hashed names the tracer happened to see: a Vite rebuild changes index-<hash>.js and assets/index-<hash>.css, and an image that registered only the names from one trace serves index.html and then 404s on its own bundle — the UI loads blank, which a smoke test that curls only / cannot see. The same rule that makes / work makes a deep link (/#/run aside, a refreshed /run) fall back to index.html, so the whole subtree is registered, not just the entry point. models/*.yml and models/**/*.yml: the boot log line 'Loaded 25 OpenAI model definitions' / 'Loaded 9 Anthropic model definitions' and the /api/models catalogue both come from the builder jar's model catalogues, and an image with nothing registered prints 'Loaded 0' and offers only the inert placeholder model. The builder's own hand-written hints register the same globs and are inherited by any image that carries the builder jar, which is every image of this module; they are restated here because /api/models is the studio's own contract and a catalogue rename in the builder must not silently reduce the studio's dropdown to one entry. The two globs are the pair the builder uses: the non-recursive one is what the loader's own listing needs, the recursive one covers a catalogue filed in a subdirectory.
